about.bio: I'm a Full-Stack Developer with experience building web products end-to-end. I'm passionate about designing robust systems and creating solutions that scale, with a product mindset and long-term vision.

jobs.description: Building REST APIs with Node.js integrated with 17+ insurance providers. Refactored the quotation engine from a low-code architecture to a modern React + Node.js stack. Designed and optimized PostgreSQL databases, enforcing security best practices and clean version control.
Built full-stack applications using React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Designed and implemented RESTful APIs and normalized database schemas to deliver scalable, tailored solutions for real clients.
Developed websites, catalogs, and redesigns using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and WordPress. Focused on responsive design, optimal UX across all devices, and direct client communication.
Bilingual (Spanish/English) customer service at one of Patagonia's most recognized tourism companies. Managed in-person, phone, and online reservations.

items.name: Aventura Andina
items.short: eCommerce + backoffice platform for a Patagonian travel agency.
items.description: Full-stack platform for a travel agency: real-time availability engine, reservation and passenger management, international payments, automated emails, and voucher generation. Led all architectural decisions, managed the UX team, and delivered a site available in 5 languages.

items.name: Seguro Market
items.short: Insurance quotation platform with real-time multi-provider API integration.
items.description: Platform that lets users compare insurance coverage and prices in real time, integrated with multiple insurer APIs. Node.js backend with concurrent data processing and PostgreSQL database.

items.name: Grupo Winding
items.short: Product catalog site with interactive energy consumption calculator.
items.description: Website for an industrial energy equipment company, featuring an interactive calculator that estimates the user's energy consumption and recommends the optimal solar panel configuration.

items.name: SignaLink APP
items.short: Mobile app that translates sign language to text and speech using AI.
items.description: Mobile application for people with speech disabilities. Connects via Bluetooth to a flex-sensor glove that detects sign language and converts it to text/speech using the OpenAI API. Features group and individual chats. Built as a university final project at UADE.

items.name: Sin Plagas
items.short: Landing page for a pest control company.
items.description: Website for a pest control company. Clean, professional design focused on conversion, presenting services, geographic coverage, and direct contact options.

items.name: Multi-DB App (Airbnb-style)
items.short: Console app using 5 database engines simultaneously.
items.description: University project for the Data Engineering II course. Implements a property rental platform using PostgreSQL, Redis, Cassandra, Neo4J, and MongoDB simultaneously, showcasing different data persistence and access patterns.

items.title: Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology Management
items.institution: UADE — Universidad Argentina de la Empresa

items.title: AWS Academy Cloud Architecting
items.detail: Cloud architecture design, AWS services, high availability, scalability, and security best practices.
